system.name: MetaFormer
system.one_liner: A vision-transformer framework for few-shot learning built only on attention: masked sample attention and patch-grained task attention with a knowledge pool.

content.variant_note: overall network (a), one layer opened into holistic attention (b), and two detail panels (c) and (d) reached by coloured dashed leaders, plus an operator legend
content.argues: Holistic attention in one transformer, combining patch, sample and task attention, embeds support and query samples together in a single feedforward pass for few-shot classification.
content.subject: MetaFormer: support and query images through patch embedding and L transformer layers whose holistic attention (task, patch, sample) is opened into two detail panels.

new_tags.name: zoom-colour-continuity
new_tags.what: the dashed leader, the fill of the source block and the frame of the detail panel share one colour (green for sample attention, yellow for task attention), so each zoom is matched by colour as well as by line

lessons.what_to_learn: Build a multi-level zoom where the leader line, the source block fill and the detail frame share one colour, and keep an operator legend so the detail panels use bare circled glyphs; show data with real photo stacks (support versus query) and a translucent highlight for what a module attends to.
lessons.suits: Transformer variants with several new attention modules (sample, patch, task), few-shot or episodic setups, where an overview must open into two or three detail drawings.

evidence: extracts feature representations of support and query samples with only one feedforward while following the inductive protocol
PTA learns a task-specific probe vector summarizing discriminative patch-level patterns and maintains a knowledge pool consolidated during meta-training

summary: MetaFormer is a few-shot learning framework built exclusively on attention in pre-trained vision transformers. Figure 1 is a four-panel overview with multi-level zoom. (a) Support and query photo stacks pass through Patch Embedding and Layers 1 to L to class probabilities, shown as a small bar chart. (b) One layer is opened into Holistic Attention: Task, Patch and Sample Attention, each followed by Add & Norm with residual loops. (c) Masked Sample Attention zooms into the sample branch: class embeddings added to support tokens, concatenation with query tokens, reshape, matrix multiplication, a Sample Causal Mask grid and softmax. (d) Patch-grained Task Attention shows a task probe vector, a Knowledge Pool with retrieval and update, aggregation, cosine similarity and fusion. A framed legend defines the circled operator glyphs.
summary_zh: MetaFormer是只用注意力的少样本框架。图1分四块逐级放大：(a)整体网络；(b)展开一层的整体注意力（任务、patch、样本）；(c)带因果掩码的掩码样本注意力；(d)带知识池的patch粒度任务注意力。
notes: The digest counts 25 placed bitmaps in all; the photo counts here (10 + 4 + 4) and the 5 token-cube glyphs were read from the preview and are approximate. The caption calls (b) a sequential mode of three modules; the drawn order bottom to top is Task, Patch, Sample Attention. Roles of Aggregation, Retrieval, Update and Fusion follow the paper's list of PTA components and the drawn arrows.
